description: Figure 9, located at the bottom of the page, presents a bar chart titled “Model Evaluation on Academic and Practical Benchmarks,” which compares the performance of two models — LLaMA-3-8B-it (blue bars) and Ours (Iterative RLHF) (orange bars) — across nine different datasets and metrics: GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench (×5), and Chat-Arena-Hard. The vertical axis, labeled “Score (%)”, ranges from 0 to 80 in increments of 10. For each benchmark, two adjacent bars show the respective scores. In most benchmarks — including GSM-8K (both ~80%), MMLU (blue ~66%, orange ~65%), HumanEval (blue ~62%, orange ~65%), ARC (blue ~59%, orange ~64%), MBPP (blue ~61%, orange ~61%), MT-Bench (×5) (blue ~41%, orange ~43%), and Chat-Arena-Hard (blue ~21%, orange ~30%) — the “Ours (Iterative RLHF)” model performs comparably or better than LLaMA-3-8B-it. Notable exceptions are TruthfulQA, where LLaMA-3-8B-it scores ~44% versus ~60% for “Ours,” and LC AlpacaEval-2, where LLaMA-3-8B-it scores ~23% versus ~32% for “Ours.” The chart includes a legend in the top-right corner identifying the two models by color. The x-axis is labeled “Dataset and Metrics,” and the overall caption below the figure reads: “Figure 9: Evaluation of our models and LLaMA-3-8B-inst.”
